speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
title: Love Like Jesus
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Ronald A. Rasband spoke about “Love Like Jesus”.

quotes.text: In our grief, we continuously ponder the whys, hows, and what ifs. We feel we have failed. We spend sleepless nights going over how we tried to draw our loved ones close to Jesus Christ and the Spirit. We preach, cajole, argue, demand, lecture, ignore, sit them down to watch general conference, and even send them links to the talks, like this one, but to no avail. If anything, these efforts can cause a greater rift.
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Book of Mormon prophet Lehi viewed in a dream “numberless concourses of people … pressing forward” to the tree of life, which is the love of Jesus Christ. But “there arose a mist of darkness,” and some “wandered off,” setting up residence in the growing skyline of great and spacious buildings. The adversary’s deceit leads to confusion and misery. He can promise no life eternal, no life with God the Father, and no peace. Not now. Not ever!
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Listen carefully. I ask you to turn over to Jesus Christ your despair for those wayward souls. We cannot change their hearts, but He can; He is a God of miracles. We love our family members and friends profoundly, but they are foremost children of our Father in Heaven, who knows and loves them even more than we do. Our Father, the great Elohim, gave His Beloved Son the authority and power necessary to heal all His children. That is the good news of the gospel. By the power of Jesus Christ’s Atonement, there is always a way back!
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Jesus Christ is the perfect embodiment of love. Love is the centerpiece of His gospel and the essence of being like Him. Love can positively influence those who have strayed. The first great commandment is to “love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.” And the second great commandment is “Love thy neighbour as thyself.” As the Primary song says, “As I have loved you, love one another.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Love is not stepping back or sanctioning others’ decisions and actions. Love is being interested in their lives, their successes, and their challenges. Love is being there with arms outstretched and a cheerful countenance. Love is lifting with faith and hope in our Lord and Savior. Love relies upon the calming influence of the Holy Ghost. The book of Proverbs teaches, “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding …, and he [will] direct thy paths.” The path is marked by love.
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Dallin H. Oaks has counseled: “Let us avoid what is harsh and hateful. Let us seek to be holy, like our Savior.” That holiness comes when we are peacemakers, when we are charitable, patient, forgiving, and kind.
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Love is expressed in prayer. In the Book of Mormon, Alma the Younger, talented and smooth-talking, “had rebelled against … God” and “had not kept his holy commandments.” An angel, “with a voice of thunder,” declared, “The Lord hath heard the prayers of his people, and also the prayers of his servant, Alma, who is thy father; for he has prayed with much faith concerning thee that thou mightest be brought to [a] knowledge of the truth … that the prayers of his servants might be answered according to their faith.” His father, Alma, had prayed for weeks, months, years, maybe decades.
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: For three long days and nights, young Alma “was racked with eternal torment.” Somewhere deep within came his father’s teachings of the coming of Jesus Christ “to atone for the sins of the world.” Alma cried in his heart, “O Jesus, thou Son of God, have mercy on me.” The love of the Savior filled him “with joy.” He became a mighty prophet and a major figure in the Book of Mormon.
quotes.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
